protocol.mmarco_note: pooled corpus = all qrel positives + reservoir sample; relative comparison across models. for absolute published full-corpus mrr@10 see published_mmarco_it_mrr10.
protocol.mldr_note: full italian mldr corpus (~10k docs), official test split
protocol.miracl_note: miracl has no italian language split; not used

Italian-ModernBERT-mmarco-mnrl.notes: same base, dense mnrl on mmarco

SauerkrautLM-Multi-ModernColBERT.notes: pylate/modernbert late-interaction tuned for 7 european languages incl. italian; the closest existing competitor to this project

mLateOn.notes: lighton multilingual pylate colbert (mmbert); includes italian

ColBERT-XM.notes: louis et al. xmod colbert; published full-corpus mmarco-it mrr@10=0.265; stanford colbert-ai checkpoint — may need custom load vs pylate

ItColBERT (phase1-only).notes: ablation: contrastive phase 1 with no distillation. tells you how much the KD stage is actually worth once phase 1 is not broken

ItColBERT.notes: mnrl init, contrastive phase 1 with mined hard negatives, single-teacher kd over a proportional split mixture, checkpoints selected on retrieval metrics
